notes.title: Release 1.1.3
notes.content:
If you purchased the game before it went free to play this update is for you! Exclusive cosmetics!

[b]New Cosmetics[/b]
[list]
[*] Supporter Crown Hat, a solid gold crown. (For those who purchased the game before it went free to play)
[*] Supporter Skin, a solid gold spider skin (For those who purchased the game before it went free to play)
[/list]

[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Throwables no longer break on hitting network players
[*] Input menu now says use G to throw throwables.
[/list]

notes.title: Release 1.1.2 - Limited Time Christmas Cosmetics, Throwable Cosmetics, and More!
notes.content:
It's late but here are some christmas cosmetics! I'm wanting to ramp up how often I do limited time cosmetics, so I'll be attempting monthly limited edition ones. This update also brings throwable cosmetics, they don't collide with players, but feel free to taunt your friends from above by throwing snowballs at them!

[b]Until December 31st you can purchase a Christmas Tree Hat and a Coal Throwable![/b]

[list]
[*] New Christmas Tree Cosmetic (Available throughout December)
[*] New Coal Throwable Cosmetic (Avaialble throughout December)
[*] New Rock Throwable Cosmetic
[*] New Snow Throwable Cosmetic
[*] New Ears Cosmetic
[*] New Prison Cosmetic
[*] Bug fix where vectors would be incorrectly sent over to other players
[*] Fixed text scaling in the shop
[*] Setup automatic shop events, so now certain halloween, christmas, etc event items will automatically appear during given times.
[/list]

[*] New Coal Throwable Cosmetic (Avaialble throughout December)

Just a small update with some new items and tweaks

[list]
[*] Bone Trail
[*] Bonk Sound Emote
[*] Headband Item
[/list]

[b]Fixes/Tweaks[/b]

[*] Collider fixed on moving platform at Tower entrance
[*] Messages didn't always fade properly should be fixed
